crossRefs.note: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,
This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed…
But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been…
Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.
translations.bsb: For I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.
translations.kjv: For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
translations.asv: For I determined not to know anything among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
